answer: Creating fake identities triggers a cost spiral, since every new identity must post fresh stake that slashes on collusion. Sybil resistance can use a staked identity kernel: each agent locks collateral, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations. A comet-like bonus rewards long-lived honest agents, raising the price of farming. An attacker must fund many stakes, sustain them through audits, and forfeit slashed collateral, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0225's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
